subject: Post-call pricing: startup program + committed-use scenarios
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@cortexai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call pricing: startup program + committed-use scenarios

Emma — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can move to a proposal: 

Call recap (30 min)
- CortexAI use-case: customer support summarization (real-time triage + nightly batch retrain).
- Expected initial traffic: ~4M tokens/mo across 20k daily queries; target scale in 6 months to 15–25M tokens/mo.
- Main constraints: latency <200ms for real-time flow, predictable spend for finance.

Immediate asks / items I promised
1) Confirm current monthly budget range you can commit to today (this quarter) and an ideal target $/1M tokens we should aim for.
2) Confirm CortexAI eligibility for startup program (you mentioned you’re in an accelerator) and whether there’s investor-backed proof of concept we can link.
3) Let me know preferred commitment window for a discount: month-to-month, 6 months, or 12 months.

Pricing context (what I shared on the call)
- Public (pay-as-you-go) list runs higher per-1M; committed terms materially reduce unit price and can include founder/startup credits.
- We can combine a startup credit + a 12-month committed tier for additional reduction.

Next steps
- If you can confirm budget band + desired commitment window, I’ll email 2 committed-use scenarios (numbers and monthly cost examples) and include a signed SOW template.
- If helpful, I can loop in Finance/Legal and provide a skeleton MAP to speed procurement.

Attached: redwood-starter-pricing.pdf (starter scenarios I referenced).

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Emma Cole <emma@cortexai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call pricing: startup program + committed-use scenarios

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap. 

Answers below: 
- Current budget: CortexAI has $7k–$12k/month we can allocate this quarter. We expect to increase to ~$30k/month within 6 months if product-market fit holds.
- Token profile: starting ~4M tokens/mo, expecting 10–20M by month 3–6 (depending on pilot success).
- Target unit economics: we were hoping to land somewhere in the $1,000–$1,500 / 1M tokens range once committed — happy to see formal scenarios.
- Startup program: we are in the Foundry accelerator (letter available). Would like to understand what that gets us (credits + faster onboarding).
- Commitment preference: we prefer trying a 6-month committed term first (less internal friction than 12 months), but 12 months is possible if pricing is compelling.

Would appreciate the committed pricing examples + an approximate monthly cost for 4M vs 15M tokens at each tier. Also flagging: procurement will want to see an estimated annual spend to approve any greater-than-$25k monthly commitment.

Thanks,
Emma Cole
Head of Product, CortexAI
emma@cortexai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@cortexai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call pricing: startup program + committed-use scenarios

Emma — thanks, super helpful. Below are three concrete, numbered scenarios to compare side-by-side. I’ve attached a short spreadsheet (commitment-scenarios.xlsx) with line-item math.

Scenario A — Pay-as-you-go (no commit)- Unit: $2,000 / 1M tokens- 4M tokens = $8,000 / month- 15M tokens = $30,000 / month

Scenario B — 6-month committed tier (example)- 20% discount off list -> $1,600 / 1M tokens- 4M tokens = $6,400 / month- 15M tokens = $24,000 / month- Minimum commit: 6 months of the committed monthly amount; upfront invoice or monthly invoicing available

Scenario C — 12-month committed + startup credit- 30% discount off list -> $1,400 / 1M tokens- 4M tokens = $5,600 / month- 15M tokens = $21,000 / month- Additional: $10k startup credit applied to first invoice + waived one-time integration fee

Notes and assumptions
- List unit above represents our standard uncommitted price for the model variant discussed (low-latency quantized variant). Exact units vary by model and latency SLAs; I’ll lock in model-specific numbers in the formal quote.
- We can flex the percent for a stronger multi-year commitment; I can propose a 35% effect if you do $X ARR commit (I’ll need an explicit target to run that).
- All scenarios include standard telemetry and token-level billing with monthly roll-ups.

Next steps I propose
1) If 6-month looks reasonable, confirm the monthly committed quantity you want to lock (eg. 4M baseline) and I’ll draft a short SOW + invoice cadence.
2) If you want to explore 12-month and the $10k credit, confirm whether you can share the Foundry accelerator acceptance letter (we’ll need it to apply startup credit).

Attaching: commitment-scenarios.xlsx (detailed math).

If you want, we can schedule 20 minutes tomorrow to walk the spreadsheet.

Best — Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call pricing: startup program + committed-use scenarios (internal)

Internal note — forwarding CortexAI thread. Key signal: they have $7k–$12k/mo today, want to land ~$1,000–$1,500 / 1M tokens once committed, and prefer a 6-month trial but may do 12 months for right economics.

Proposal ask: approve a negotiable path where we offer: 6-month at 20% (standard) OR 12-month at 25–30% plus $10k startup credit if they provide Foundry letter and commit to a minimum $150k ARR (or equivalent 12-mo spend).

Marissa — can we push a 25% floor for 12mo with the $10k credit and require Finance sign-off for anything below $120k? Karthik — if we escalate to a 35% concession, I’ll flag to Legal and Sales Leadership; need your read.

Thanks — Ben
